tournament.advancement.intro: Route this Stage's finishers into later Stages by placement. Add a band, set how many places it covers, and pick where it goes; check more than one destination to split it evenly (snake). Bands stack from the top, then everyone left falls into Remaining. Advancement is explicit: whatever a band (Remaining included) routes nowhere is eliminated.
tournament.criteria.blurb.series: the recurring program it belongs to
tournament.gameCorrection.sourceLabel: {source} labels this {game}{catalogued, select, no { (not in the catalog)} other {}}. The source label can itself be wrong, so pick what was actually played.
tournament.projected.caption.projected: The draw played to seed: every favorite holds, until the earlier stages decide it.
tournament.projected.caption.projectedRe: The draw played to seed: the result if every favorite holds.
tournament.rating.noCommunityNote: This event isn't attached to a community, so each rating is labeled with where it was earned.
tournament.rebuild.corrections: These manual corrections were applied in place and will be lost. Re-apply them afterward:
tournament.rebuild.description: Every entrant and the whole bracket are pulled again from the source, replacing all bracket data: grand finals, stages and scores. VODs, prizes and organizers are kept.
tournament.rebuild.row.description: Re-pull entrants and bracket from the source, replacing all bracket data (grand finals, stages, scores). VODs, prizes and organizers are kept.
tournament.set.report.confirmNote: The winner advances in the bracket right away. A mistake can still be corrected from the game log.
tournament.set.toOnly.deprioritise: Only a TO can deprioritize a player
tournament.settings.name.help: This bracket’s name, to tell sibling brackets apart. Leave blank for “{name}.”
tournament.settings.roles.note: Credits a host of this bracket only. {listed, select, yes {Event-wide organizers ({names}) also appear on every bracket, and are} other {Event-wide organizers are}} managed on the event page's <link>Roles & staff</link>, along with the rest of the event’s staff.
tournament.stage.format.clearsBands: This Stage's advancement bands no longer apply once it becomes {to}, so saving clears them. Route its finishers again from Routing afterward, or set the format back to {from} to keep them.
tournament.standings.provisional.body: These finalize when the stage completes.
tournament.standings.refetch.warning: Refetching wipes and rebuilds this tournament from its source. The following manual corrections were applied in-place and will be lost. Re-apply them afterward:
tournament.tiebreak.third.note: Play a 3rd place match between the semifinal losers. It joins the queue once both are out.
